comment: MECHANISM test for the inspect-before-python guard (deterministic intercept). The prompt forces gsheets_run_python WITHOUT a prior gsheets_read, so the guard MUST intercept the first call with an inspect_first envelope (markdown preview of 'Ventas'); the agent then re-calls and, having seen the real Categoria column, applies +10 to the 3 frutas. Distinct from gsheets_inspect_guard_e2e.json (which uses a realistic vague prompt where flash often reads first on its own, so the guard acts as a backstop). Replace <SPREADSHEET_ID> per the gsheets E2E runbook.

test_payload.prompt:
Use this exact spreadsheet_id (copy character-by-character): <SPREADSHEET_ID>
NO leas la hoja antes. Llamá DIRECTAMENTE a gsheets_run_python (sin gsheets_read previo) con binding {var:'v', spreadsheet_id:'<SPREADSHEET_ID>', sheet:'Ventas'} y write_to_spreadsheet:'<SPREADSHEET_ID>', y en el código sumá 10 al Monto de las frutas. Guardá el cambio.

config.system_message: Asistente de Google Sheets. Copiá el spreadsheet_id verbatim.
